parameters.query:
with candidate as materialized (
  select
    ci.content_id,
    ci.title,
    ci.status,
    ci.target_duration_seconds,
    ci.source_payload_json,
    s.narration_script,
    coalesce(s.raw_response_json->>'v2_story_package', 'false') as is_v2_story_package,
    sb.storyboard_json,
    count(distinct a.scene_number)::int as scene_asset_count,
    coalesce(d.director_json, '{}'::jsonb) as director_json
  from content_items ci
  join scripts s on s.content_id = ci.content_id
  join storyboards sb on sb.content_id = ci.content_id
  left join directors d on d.content_id = ci.content_id
  join assets a on a.content_id = ci.content_id and a.asset_role in ('scene_image', 'scene_video') and a.status = 'ready'
  where ci.status = 'assets_ready'
  group by ci.content_id, ci.title, ci.status, ci.target_duration_seconds, ci.source_payload_json, s.narration_script, s.raw_response_json, sb.storyboard_json, d.director_json
  having count(distinct a.scene_number) >= jsonb_array_length(sb.storyboard_json)
  order by max(ci.updated_at) asc
  limit 1
), claim as (
  update content_items ci
  set status = 'generating_narration',
      updated_at = now()
  where ci.content_id = (select content_id from candidate)
    and ci.status = 'assets_ready'
  returning ci.content_id
)
select
  c.content_id,
  c.title,
  c.status,
  c.target_duration_seconds,
  c.source_payload_json,
  c.narration_script,
  c.is_v2_story_package,
  c.storyboard_json,
  c.scene_asset_count,
  c.director_json
from candidate c
join claim cl on cl.content_id = c.content_id;

with deleted as (
  delete from assets
  where content_id = '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid
    and asset_role = 'scene_narration'
), inserted as (
  insert into assets (
    content_id,
    scene_number,
    asset_role,
    provider,
    source_url,
    storage_url,
    mime_type,
    duration_seconds,
    status,
    metadata_json
  )
  select
    '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid,
    (scene->>'scene_number')::integer,
    'scene_narration',
    scene->>'provider',
    scene->>'source_url',
    scene->>'storage_url',
    scene->>'mime_type',
    (scene->>'duration_seconds')::float,
    'ready',
    scene->'metadata_json'
  from jsonb_array_elements('{{$json.scenes_json_sql}}'::jsonb) as scene
  returning 1
)
select
  '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid as content_id,
  'scene_narration' as asset_role,
  count(*)::int as asset_count
from inserted;

update content_items
set status = 'narration_ready',
    updated_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Narration SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid
returning content_id, title, status, updated_at;

insert into workflow_runs (
  content_id,
  workflow_name,
  run_status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Narration SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid,
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Narration SQL Values"].json["workflow_name_sql"]}}',
  'success',
  '{{$item(0).$node["Parse Narration Result"].json["run_started_at"]}}'::timestamptz,
  now(),
  {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Narration SQL Values"].json["duration_ms_sql"]}},
  null,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'generation_model', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Narration SQL Values"].json["generation_model_sql"]}}', ''),
    'voice', nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Narration SQL Values"].json["voice_sql"]}}', ''),
    'scene_count', {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Narration SQL Values"].json["scene_count_sql"]}},
    'total_duration_seconds', {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Narration SQL Values"].json["total_duration_seconds_sql"]}},
    'cost', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Narration SQL Values"].json["cost_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb
  )
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, ended_at;
